description: Can mail from this domain be spoofed? Returns MX, the SPF record and how strict it is, the DMARC policy, DKIM keys found under common selectors, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a spoofable verdict and findings. Use it to judge a sender's domain or audit your own before sending. Live DNS lookups. 5 free calls per day across all tools; pass `key` to use a prepaid balance (0.005 USDC per call).
name: email_auth
